title: A conformance row
description: One row of a named group in a spec file. Layers add their own fields (additionalProperties is true on purpose); lib/spec.mjs is the executable validator and tolerates unknown fields with a warning.

op.description: Abstract operation, e.g. sandbox.create. The language adapter maps it to a call.

expect.description: What the layer asserts: { result } or { error: { type, status, code, retryable } } or { requests: n } ...

live.description: Also run against staging by the live runner (stateless rows only).

mock.description: Scripted gateway: ordered exchanges the code under test must make.

body.description: Deep subset of the JSON body; null = no body; leaves may be matchers.

oneOf.description: A row of spec/gateway-responses.json by id.

times.description: Repeat this exchange n times (retry tables).
